renderer_observations.note: Poppler and MuPDF 300 DPI GT/before/after crops preserve the three title lines and subtitle content, font, weight, tracking, wraps, and vertical baselines; the candidate moves every table line exactly 0.10pt right and leaves only dispersed glyph-edge rasterization.

Poppler and MuPDF 300 DPI crops preserve the centered ALL AGES WELCOME block, gate line, diamond outline, circular hairline, and dot pattern; trace residuals are at most 0.024pt in x and 0.067pt in y.
The full-page and crop diff localize every photo-class material cluster to the rotated clipped photograph; the geometry and clip boundary match, and only JPEG-versus-lossless resampling remains.
